neighbours.label: A scalar intensifier that pushes a comparison further: 'even' before a comparative ('even more', 'even bigger') and 'also the most', not a plain comparative 'more X than' or a bare additive 'also'.
fire: The sequel was good, but the third film was even better than both.
Prices rose last year, and this winter they climbed even higher.
The old bridge was narrow, and the new one is even narrower.
Tokyo is a huge city, and it is also the most crowded one I have visited.
Her second novel sold well, and her third was even more successful.
This trail is steep, and it is also the most dangerous in the park.
The storm last night was loud, but the one before it was even louder.
Wheat is cheap to grow here, and it is also the most widely eaten grain.
quiet: The sequel was good, but the third film was better than both.
Prices rose last year, and this winter they climbed higher.
The old bridge was narrow, and the new one is not much wider.
Tokyo is a huge city, and it is also very clean and safe.
Her second novel sold well, and her third was a success too.
This trail is steep, and it is also closed in winter.
The storm last night was loud, but the one before it was quiet.
Wheat is cheap to grow here, and farmers sell it in town.

notes: Probes (fraction of max 10.0): 'was even more popular' 0.392 peaking on ' even', 'is also the most common' 0.409 on ' most', 'will again be hosted' 0.185, 'also more reliable' 0.114, 'work better' 0.131. Plain 'more reliable than' 0.009, 'was also tired' 0.034, 'bought more apples' 0.000. Fire items use 'even + comparative' and 'also the most'.
